# QuotaPin 1.0.1

One download, two ways in.

- Double-click `QuotaPin-1.0.1.exe` for the guided Windows setup, tray companion, startup, and Apps uninstall entry.
- The PowerShell Quick Start downloads the same executable and installs the quiet watcher mode without starting the tray.
- Slow downloads show progress and resume after an interruption.
- Install, update, and uninstall leave Codex open. If the current Codex window was not prepared for attachment, QuotaPin waits for the next normal Codex launch.

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WSL043/QuotaPin-for-Codex/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

Windows 10 version 2004 or newer, x64, with the current Codex desktop app.
